empty.observation: Clear Home heading, provider selector and composer; two suggestion labels use ellipses but remain identifiable.

message.observation: Synthetic request/reply and reply actions are legible, with no overlap with the composer.

reset.observation: Reset returns to empty Home with selected Synthetic vLLM provider and an empty composer.

settings.observation: Set up heading, enabled reasoning and context/extensions rows are legible; Tools section starts with a capital.

dark.observation: Dark background, light text and blue icons retain visible contrast; composer and navigation remain distinct.

small_screen.observation: Home controls and composer fit the narrow display; suggestion text is shortened with ellipses.

large_text.observation: At 200% text, suggestion labels collapse to Analyze ..., Open W..., Browse t..., Check m...; their actions are not sufficiently identifiable.

keyboard.observation: Two-line draft and blue Send button stay above the keyboard without overlap.

reduced_motion.observation: Static reduced-motion screen is legible; a screenshot cannot verify animation behavior or haptics.

menu.observation: New conversation, Open terminal and Open browser popup rows are legible with distinct icons.

providers.observation: Provider selection is legible, but Add vLLM title and endpoint description remain French. English wording is prepared in the next correction.

tools.observation: Tools title is capitalized, but first tool name is reduced to dots next to the long accessibility badge.

appearance.observation: Large Appearance & Theme page title truncates to Appearance & The..., although settings controls are legible.

improvements.observation: New App improvements heading, Power instructions, GitHub connection field and repository-scoped token action are legible in English; remaining content continues below the viewport.

regression_fixture.observation: Intentional solid red rectangle covers the upper Home area and hides the provider/header/heading.

_reference_comparison.observation: No approved reference for the new App improvements page; existing layout issues are reported independently. Physical Samsung interaction and haptics were not tested.
